title: ApprovalWorkItemCondition - Data API
description: Represents a condition for starting and concluding an approval step that's evaluated as part of the smart approval process. This object is available in API version 64.0 and later.

ApprovalWorkItemCriteriaId.description: The approval work item criteria associated with the approval work item condition. The approval work item criteria defines the logic by which the approval conditions are evaluated. This field is a relationship field.

ConditionSequencePosition.description: The order in which the condition is evaluated relative to other conditions that are part of the requirement logic.

HasEvaluationSucceeded.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
HasEvaluationSucceeded.description: Indicates whether the first value (left side) evaluates against the second value (right side) successfully (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

IsConditionExcluded.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsConditionExcluded.description: Indicates whether the condition must be excluded from evaluation (true) or not (false) in an auto-approval process. The default value is false.

LeftValue.description: The first value of the condition that's evaluated against the second value.

LeftValueDataType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
LeftValueDataType.description: The data type of the first operand (left side) in this condition. Possible values are: Apex Boolean Currency Date DateTime—Date/Time MultiSelectPicklist—Multi-Select Picklist Number Other Picklist Text Time

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The sequentially-generated name of the approval work item condition record, for example AWCO-000000071.

OperatorType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
OperatorType.description: The operator for the condition. Possible values are: Contains EndsWith Equal GreaterThan GreaterThanOrEqualTo HasError In IsBlank IsChanged IsEmpty IsNull LessThan LessThanOrEqualTo None NotEqualTo NotIn StartsWith WasSelected WasSet WasVisited

RightValue.description: The second value (right side) of the condition that's evaluated against the first value.

RightValueDataType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
RightValueDataType.description: The data type of the second operand for the condition. Possible values are: Apex Boolean Currency Date DateTime—Date/Time MultiSelectPicklist—Multi-Select Picklist Number Other Picklist Text Time

special_access_rules:
This object is available in Enterprise, Professional, Unlimited, and Developer Editions where Advanced Approvals is enabled with the Modify All Data or the Approval Admin user permission.
